hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q '\.go"'; then changed_files=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep '\.go$' | head -5); if [ -n "$changed_files" ]; then gofmt -w $changed_files 2>/dev/null && echo "gofmt: formatted $changed_files"; fi; fi

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q '\.go"'; then changed_files=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep '\.go$' | head -5); if [ -n "$changed_files" ]; then gofmt -w $changed_files 2>/dev/null && echo "gofmt: formatted $changed_files"; fi; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(\.pb\.go|\_gen\.go|\_mock\.go|/mocks/|/generated/)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Cannot modify generated files (.pb.go, _gen.go, _mock.go, mocks/, generated/)' && exit 2; fi
